name: SASRA Licensed and Authorised SACCO Societies 2026
source: Sacco Societies Regulatory Authority - List of Licensed and Authorised Sacco Societies in Kenya for the Financial Year ending 31st December 2026 (dated 3 February 2026)
notes: Categories: deposit_taking = Schedule I (176). non_withdrawable_deposit_taking = Schedule II (176), authorised for specified non-deposit-taking BOSA-only business. restricted_credit_only = Schedule III (5), conditionally restricted licences that bar new deposits. Schedule IV (Nufaika, merged and revoked) and Schedule V (PESA Sacco, authorisation expired) are excluded. Location = county of head office as printed. Head office and postal address are in notes. The list gives no licence numbers. Licence period is 1 Jan-31 Dec 2026. One fix: 'MajaneesRegulated' was split to 'Majanees Regulated', and this is noted on the row.
